시편 100:1.content: A Psalm of praise. Make a joyful noise unto the Lord, all ye lands.

시편 100:2.content: Serve the Lord with gladness: come before his presence with singing.

시편 100:3.content: Know ye that the Lord he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

시편 100:4.content: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

시편 100:5.content: For the Lord is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.
